capabilities: move notes to folders when a frontmatter property matches a rule
watch the vault root and additional chosen folders
match single-value and YAML list property values
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; manual installation instructions are included but no community-plugin marketplace install steps.
problem: Obsidian does not automatically file notes into folders based on their property values, so users must move notes manually to keep them organized.
summary: Rule-based file mover that relocates notes to folders when their YAML frontmatter properties match configured property/value rules.
